name: Untitled Sandbox Game
desc:
Highly recommended to play in private servers with your friends.
Untitled Sandbox Game is a Sandbox where you can... 

  🔨 - Build Houses, Bunkers, Castles and More! 
  🔧 - Become an Engineer and make Mechanisms 
  🚗 - Build Cars and Planes! 
  ❔ - Find Secrets and get Achievements! 
  🗡️ - Fight with other Players!
  💣 - Cause Chaos and explode your device! (in private servers)
  💥 - DESTROY EVERYTHING! (in private servers)
  🎈 - Play around with gears, weapons, toys!
  And more... and more...

Some locked items from the inventory are FREE on VIP Servers!
💰 - You can get 10 "Coins" every 5 minutes by playing or every time you place 100 blocks! However, you can't get "Coins" for placing blocks on the VIP servers.
Use the "/handto {PlayerName}" command to give the mentioned player the item you are currently holding.

have fun!!
